answer: Bind each identity to one hardware enclave whose crystal attestation proves a distinct device, so a farm cannot mint clones from a single server. New identities then climb a knoll of trust: rewards start under a velvet cap and rise only after unrelated peers attest to real work over several epochs. Cloning 1,000 agents means buying 1,000 enclaves and waiting out each ramp, costing far more than the capped rewards pay. The limit is hardware trust itself: a compromised enclave vendor or stolen device batch could forge the root, so enclave firmware must be publicly audited and revocable.
